scenarios.name: End Pan using its context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid visible in the MCAD Software
Pan is active from the viewport navigation bar
the user right-clicks an empty area of the viewport
a contextual menu offers Done, OK, Home View, Orbit, Zoom and Previous View
the status area still indicates Pan is active
the contextual menu closes and the status area displays Ready
the same part and solid remain visible
